latin_incipit: Possibile est tenendo unitatem intellectus: animam meam ita particulariter meam remanere post mortem.
english_translation: It is possible—while affirming the unity of the intellect—for my soul, in such a way particularly mine and not common to all, to remain after death.
charge: [None: this is Pico's position, not Averroes's]
defense: Pico here synthesizes Averroism with Christian theology, preserving individual immortality against monopsychism.
exegesis: Pico insists personal survival is possible even if intellect is in some sense universal. He suggests a synthesis: intellect may be shared, but the soul retains personal identity, preserving immortality. This reflects Christian concerns with individuality and resurrection.

scholar_citations.work: Syncretism in the West: Pico's Platform

notes: Marks Pico's philosophical solution to the monopsychism problem, bridging Averroism and Christian anthropology.
